items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 10 July 2026 at 7:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the area.


##Wind##

Northerly 2 to 4 occasionally 5 in the west, but variable 3 or less in the east of the area, veering east or northeast 3 to 5 in all waters overnight.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Areas of mist and isolated fog patches, mainly in the east and south. Becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Mainly good, but poor or very poor in mist and fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4 occasionally 5 in places.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Mainly good.
